Vinícius Jr. faces pressure at Real Madrid

Real Madrid•Oct 5, 2026
Full Story
Football Stories · Real Madrid

The Brazilian superstar is facing criticism after a difficult start to the season with Real Madrid.

Vinícius Jr. has found himself under increasing pressure at Real Madrid following a difficult period for the Brazilian forward.

After becoming one of the most decisive players at the club in recent seasons, Vinícius is now being questioned over his current form and his role within José Mourinho's new Real Madrid team.

The situation became particularly difficult during the Madrid derby against Atlético.

Real Madrid suffered a 2–1 defeat at the Metropolitano, and Vinícius was substituted shortly after the beginning of the second half.

The Brazilian's performance attracted criticism, with the match becoming another example of the difficulties Real Madrid have experienced at the start of the new campaign.

This is a significant change from the Vinícius who helped Real Madrid win major trophies and became one of the world's most dangerous attackers.

The forward remains an important part of the club's plans, but expectations surrounding him are extremely high.

There is also another factor making the situation more interesting.

Vinícius was recently nominated for the 2026 Ballon d'Or after another impressive individual season, during which he scored 22 goals and provided nine assists for Real Madrid. He also played an important role for Brazil at the World Cup.

That means the current criticism should be viewed in the context of a player who has already established himself among the world's elite.

Real Madrid will need Vinícius at his best as the season develops.

HighlightFor the Brazilian, the answer is simple: performances. If he can return to his best level, the current criticism could quickly disappear. But if the difficult performances continue, questions surrounding his form, his role and his future at Real Madrid will only become louder.

Cristiano Ronaldo walks out of Portugal camp

Portugal•Oct 1, 2026
Full Story
Football Stories · Portugal

Cristiano Ronaldo's relationship with Portugal's new manager Jorge Jesus has erupted into a major controversy.

Cristiano Ronaldo has abruptly left Portugal's national-team camp after tensions emerged between the 41-year-old captain and new head coach Jorge Jesus.

The controversy began after Ronaldo was left on the bench during Portugal's Nations League victory over Norway.

Jesus later explained that Ronaldo had been expected to start on the bench against Denmark as part of the coach's plans. However, Ronaldo reportedly felt frustrated by the situation.

The situation escalated after Jesus held a press conference in which he discussed Ronaldo's position within the team.

Shortly afterwards, Ronaldo decided to leave the national-team camp in Copenhagen.

The Portuguese Football Federation confirmed his departure, while Ronaldo himself explained on social media that he had made the decision after the manager's press conference and a conversation with FPF president Pedro Proença.

The Portugal captain also said that he would reveal the truth about what happened "in due course."

Jorge Jesus has denied that there was a serious incident between the two men, insisting that Ronaldo had been upset about being left out but that there had been no major confrontation.

The controversy has nevertheless created huge debate in Portugal.

Ronaldo has been the face of the national team for more than two decades. He is Portugal's most-capped player and its all-time leading scorer, making his relationship with the national team particularly significant.

The situation has also raised questions about his international future.

At 41 years old, Ronaldo has already confirmed that the 2026 World Cup was his final World Cup. Now, however, there is uncertainty over whether he will continue representing Portugal beyond the current international period.

Bruno Fernandes has since rejected suggestions of a split inside the squad and said that he had spoken with Ronaldo. He also described Ronaldo as the greatest symbol of Portuguese football and the country.

HighlightFor now, the biggest question remains unanswered: Will Cristiano Ronaldo return to Portugal, or has one of the greatest international careers in football history entered its final chapter?

Football Stories 96 will continue to follow the story as new information emerges.

Manchester City found guilty of 114 financial breaches

Premier League•Sep 29, 2026
Full Story
Football Stories · Premier League

Manchester City have been found guilty of 114 of the 115 financial breaches brought against the club by the Premier League.

After years of investigation and legal proceedings, one of the biggest financial cases in football history has finally reached its first major verdict.

An independent commission has found Manchester City guilty of almost all of the Premier League's allegations relating to their finances between the 2009/10 and 2017/18 seasons.

The case originally contained 115 alleged breaches. The commission found the club guilty of all but one of them, including every charge relating to serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules.

According to the commission, Manchester City used a number of commercial agreements that were described as "sham" contracts. These arrangements allegedly allowed the club to artificially increase its reported revenues and reduce its costs.

The investigation found that more than £900 million was involved in the disputed financial arrangements. A large part of that figure related to sponsorship payments that were allegedly funded by companies connected to the club's Abu Dhabi ownership rather than entirely by the sponsors themselves.

The commission also found that Manchester City submitted inaccurate financial information to auditors and football authorities.

The charges covered not only Premier League financial regulations, but also UEFA's spending rules and the club's obligation to cooperate with the Premier League's investigation.

Three of the four alleged breaches relating to cooperation with the investigation were also upheld. The commission concluded that City had made significant efforts to obstruct or frustrate parts of the investigation.

The case began with a Premier League investigation in 2018, before the formal charges were finally announced in February 2023.

The hearing itself lasted 42 days and concluded in December 2024. The final decision was then delayed for a lengthy period before the verdict was finally made public in September 2026.

Manchester City have consistently denied the allegations.

Following the verdict, the club said it remained confident in its position and indicated that it would appeal the decision.

The punishment has not yet been decided.

Manchester City could potentially face a range of sanctions, including a fine, a points deduction or other sporting penalties. The commission will determine the sanction separately, while the appeal process could take considerably longer.

For Manchester City, this means that the 114 guilty findings are not necessarily the end of the story.

But after years of waiting, the Premier League has finally established its position on one of the most important financial cases in its history.

HighlightNow, everyone is waiting for the next question: What punishment will Manchester City receive?

Football Stories 96 will continue to follow the case and bring you the latest developments.

Mbappé leaves Nike and joins On

Business•Sep 24, 2026
Full Story
Football Stories · Business

Mbappé leaves Nike after 20 years and joins On. The Real Madrid star becomes the face of the Swiss brand’s entry into football.

Kylian Mbappé has officially ended his long relationship with Nike and signed with Swiss sportswear company On, marking one of the biggest changes of his commercial career.

The French superstar had been associated with Nike since 2006, when he was just a child. After nearly two decades with the American company, Mbappé will now become a global ambassador for On.

The move is particularly significant because On has traditionally been known for running and tennis rather than football. The company is now preparing to enter the football market, with its first football boots expected to arrive in 2027.

Mbappé will not simply promote the brand. According to reports, the agreement also makes him a shareholder in the company, while allowing him to participate in the development of football products and boots.

The Swiss company has also appointed French football legend Thierry Henry as its director of football, strengthening its plans to establish itself in the sport.

Mbappé explained that what attracted him to On was the opportunity to build something new and help shape the future of football.

The financial details of the agreement have not been publicly revealed, although On confirmed that the deal contains both cash and equity components.

For Nike, the departure represents the end of a partnership that lasted around 20 years. It also comes after the company lost other major football names to rival brands.

For On, however, signing one of the biggest footballers in the world gives the company an immediate global face as it prepares to enter the football boot market.

HighlightMbappé has therefore gone from being one of Nike's most recognizable football stars to becoming one of the main figures behind a completely new football brand.

Julián Álvarez stays at Atlético Madrid

Transfers•Sep 23, 2026
Full Story
Football Stories · Transfers

Julián Álvarez remains at Atlético Madrid after failed transfer attempt. The Argentine striker now faces a difficult situation at the Spanish club.

Julián Álvarez will remain an Atlético Madrid player after failing to secure a move during the summer transfer window.

The Argentine forward had been at the centre of one of the biggest transfer stories of the summer, with Barcelona reportedly interested in bringing him to Spain.

However, Atlético Madrid refused to let their striker leave.

The club's CEO, Miguel Ángel Gil Marín, had already made the position of Atlético clear during the summer, saying the club did not want to sell Álvarez and would not accept offers of €100 million, €150 million or even €200 million.

Álvarez therefore remains under contract with Atlético until 2030.

But the situation has become complicated.

According to reports from Spain and Argentina, the striker had been unhappy with his situation and wanted to leave the club. The transfer window eventually closed without an agreement being reached with another team.

The beginning of the season has also been difficult.

Álvarez played only once during the early part of the crisis and was reportedly left out of matches against Málaga and Sevilla. He also missed several training sessions.

His return to the squad now becomes an important issue for Diego Simeone.

Atlético need to rebuild their relationship with one of their most important attackers, while Álvarez needs to focus on football again after a summer dominated by transfer speculation.

The biggest question is whether the Argentine can put the failed transfer attempt behind him and return to his best level in Madrid.

HighlightFor now, there is no transfer. Julián Álvarez is staying at Atlético Madrid — at least until the next opportunity to change his future arrives.

Ballon d'Or 2026: the race is wide open

Ballon d'Or•Sep 22, 2026
Full Story
Football Stories · Ballon d'Or

The Ballon d'Or race is heating up. Mbappé, Yamal, Dembélé and Kane are among the biggest names competing for the award.

The 2026 Ballon d'Or race has officially entered its final stage, with some of the biggest names in world football competing for the prestigious individual award.

The official men's shortlist contains 30 players, with the winner scheduled to be announced in London on October 26.

Among the leading names are last year's winner Ousmane Dembélé, Kylian Mbappé, Lamine Yamal and Harry Kane.

Mbappé enters the race after a huge individual season, while Yamal has continued to establish himself as one of the most important young players in world football.

Harry Kane is also among the major contenders after a remarkable scoring campaign with Bayern Munich. One recent ranking placed Kane at the top after he scored 61 goals in 51 matches for Bayern.

But the competition does not stop there.

Rodri, Lionel Messi, Jude Bellingham, Michael Olise, Erling Haaland, Declan Rice and several other stars are also included in the conversation.

The interesting part of this year's race is that several candidates have completely different arguments. Some have incredible individual statistics. Others have won major trophies. And some have combined individual performances with success for both club and country.

Lamine Yamal has already addressed the Ballon d'Or discussion, saying the decision is not ultimately in his hands and that he believes he has done an incredible job with Barcelona and Spain.

With the ceremony approaching, every performance could become important.

HighlightThe question now is simple: Who will be crowned the best player in the world for 2026?

Vinícius Jr. faces a difficult moment at Real Madrid

Real Madrid•Sep 21, 2026
Full Story
Football Stories · Real Madrid

Vinícius Jr. is going through one of the most difficult periods of his Real Madrid career. The Brazilian now has to respond after a disappointing Madrid derby.

Vinícius Jr. is facing increasing attention after a difficult start to the season with Real Madrid.

The Brazilian winger has been one of the club's most important players in recent years, but his current performances have attracted criticism.

The situation reached a new level during the Madrid derby against Atlético.

Real Madrid suffered a 2–1 defeat at the Metropolitano, with the match ending in a heated atmosphere. Vinícius was substituted shortly after the beginning of the second half.

According to Spanish newspaper AS, the derby represented a particularly difficult moment for the Brazilian, who recognizes that his current performances are below the level he expects from himself.

This comes at an important moment for Real Madrid.

José Mourinho's team are dealing with a number of challenges early in the season, while the club is also trying to establish its new tactical system.

Vinícius remains one of the team's biggest attacking weapons, meaning his return to his best level could be extremely important for Madrid.

The Brazilian now has a clear objective: respond on the pitch.

HighlightAfter years of becoming one of Real Madrid's decisive players, Vinícius will be looking to turn this difficult period around and show why he remains one of the club's most important attackers. The next few matches could therefore be crucial for him.

Rodrygo's Real Madrid future enters another chapter

Real Madrid•Sep 20, 2026
Full Story
Football Stories · Real Madrid

Rodrygo is getting closer to his return at Real Madrid. But his future could become one of the club's biggest questions.

Rodrygo is continuing his recovery from the serious knee injury that has kept him away from football for months.

The Brazilian suffered damage to his anterior cruciate ligament and meniscus in his right knee in March, undergoing surgery shortly afterwards.

His rehabilitation has progressed in recent weeks, with the player already working on the pitch as he prepares for the next stage of his recovery.

Real Madrid are currently working with the possibility of having Rodrygo fully available around January 2027, although the player is reportedly determined to return earlier.

His return could be extremely important for José Mourinho.

Rodrygo offers versatility across the attack and has already played a major role in some of Real Madrid's biggest matches during his career.

But his future could also become a major talking point.

Reports have indicated renewed interest from Arsenal, although there is currently no agreement for a transfer. Rodrygo remains under contract with Real Madrid until 2028.

For now, however, the priority is his recovery.

Real Madrid are continuing to monitor his progress carefully, while Rodrygo works towards returning to full fitness.

If everything goes according to plan, the Brazilian could be back on the pitch around the beginning of 2027.

HighlightAnd when he returns, one major question will remain: Will Rodrygo stay at Real Madrid, or could his future change after his comeback?
